hero.question: Is your company's number getting banned when you message customers?

intro.text: If your company relies on WhatsApp to talk to customers or run marketing campaigns, you may face a restricted or banned number, especially when you use unsuitable sending methods or message heavily without following WhatsApp's policies.
intro.highlight: The solution isn't to stop using WhatsApp, but to use it the right way.
intro.platform: With HRwhats, you can move from regular WhatsApp use to a professional environment built on the WhatsApp Business Platform (API), and manage your company's communication and campaigns in a more organized way.

reasons.title: Why might a WhatsApp number get banned?
reasons.lead: The risk of account restrictions can rise with practices such as:
items: Sending large numbers of messages through unofficial methods.
Using unapproved sending software or tools.
Messaging people who didn't expect to hear from your business.
High rates of people blocking or reporting your messages.
Not giving customers a clear way to stop the messages.

honest.question: Does the WhatsApp API prevent bans completely?
honest.statement: No method can guarantee 100% that an account won't be restricted.
honest.text: Using the WhatsApp Business Platform the right way helps companies manage communication and campaigns through official channels, but you must also follow WhatsApp's policies, consent requirements, and message quality standards.

sections.title: Introduction
text: The HRwhats platform is committed to protecting the privacy of its users and maintaining the confidentiality of their personal data. This policy explains how information is collected, used, stored, and protected when the website or its associated services are used.

sections.title: Information we collect
text: We may collect certain information necessary to provide our services, including:
list: Billing and payment data when purchases are completed.
Technical information such as IP address, browser type, operating system, and usage history.
Any information the user provides to us when contacting the support team.

sections.title: How we use information
text: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
list: Creating and managing the user's account.
Providing the services and activating subscriptions.
Improving the platform's performance and developing its features.
Communicating with the user regarding requests, updates, or important notices.
Providing technical support and customer service.
Complying with laws and legal requirements where necessary.

sections.title: Information sharing
text: We do not sell or rent users' personal data. Some information may be shared with trusted service providers or technology partners where necessary to provide or operate the service, with a commitment to maintaining the confidentiality of the data, or where required by laws and regulations.

sections.title: Data protection
text: We work to implement appropriate security, technical, and administrative measures to protect data against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction, taking into account the best available security practices.

sections.title: Cookies
text: The website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve the user experience, analyze performance, and personalize certain features. The user can manage these cookies through their browser settings.

sections.title: Data retention
text: Personal data is retained for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by laws and by legal and regulatory obligations.

sections.title: Third-party links
text: The platform may contain links to, or integrations with, external services or websites. HRwhats is not responsible for the privacy policies or practices of those third parties, and it is advisable to review their policies before using their services.

sections.title: User rights
text: In accordance with applicable laws, the user may request that their data be updated or corrected, request its deletion, or object to certain aspects of its processing, where this is possible and does not conflict with legal or operational obligations.

sections.title: Children's privacy
text: HRwhats services are not intended to collect personal data from children under the legally permitted age. If any such data is found, it will be handled in accordance with applicable laws.

sections.title: Changes to this privacy policy
text: This policy may be amended from time to time to keep pace with regulatory, technical, or operational developments, and the updated version takes effect as soon as it is published on the website.

sections.title: Contact us
text: For any questions or requests regarding the privacy policy or the processing of personal data, the support team can be contacted through the official channels listed on the website.
